final_label: D1 after a rewarded common a1->S1 trial (window start: rewarded D1 while belief favours S1), silent in the last ~15 trials of the episode

with_model_outputs.label: D1 after a rewarded S1 trial, when about to choose a1 again
with_model_outputs.explanation: Fires only at D1 (never at GO or D2), and only when the reward input is 1. Within that, it needs the previous trial to have reached S1 (prev_state == 1; -1 is the window first trial, where prev_state is unknown) and the agent to be about to choose a1. In short it is a reward-at-S1 -> repeat a1 signal. The only FUTURE variable is the agent own upcoming choice (action at D1), which the agent computes, so it is legitimate. With observed variables only, (phase==D1)&(in_rew==1)&isin(prev_state,[1,-1]) has recall 1.0 but precision 0.60 (dev F1 0.75). Adding action==1 lifts dev F1 to 0.90 with mass recall 1.0. Almost silent after rewarded S2 trials, after unrewarded trials, and at every GO/D2 step. Magnitude builds over a run of consecutive rewarded a1/S1 trials: it is weak (0.1-0.4) on the first one and saturates near 1.0 after several. It tracks good==S1 and the D1 value bin around 7.5-7.7. Most false positives are rewarded-S1 D1 steps that follow an unrewarded or rare streak break.

issues: The label's 'rewarded S1 trial' conflates the reached state with the chosen action. The feature needs the previous trial to have been a1 with a COMMON transition (a1 -> S1), not just to have reached S1. On dev, (D1)&(in_rew==1)&(prev_state==1)&(prev_action==2) (a rare a2 -> S1 rewarded trial) has precision 0.11 and mass recall 0.003. Even when the agent then switches to a1, which is the model-based move, precision is only 0.37 (4340 predicted steps, mass 0.3%). The original predicate isin(prev_state,[1,-1]) includes this whole class, so it is a systematic false-positive class and not scattered noise. It is also the exact case that separates a state-based (model-based) reading from an action-based one, and the activations favour the action-based reading.

Every active step does have prev_action in {1,-1} with a common transition. (D1)&(in_rew==1)&(prev_state==2)&(prev_action==1) (rare a1 -> S2) is 0 for recall and mass. prev_action==2 holds only 0.3% of the activation mass.

The claim that 'most false positives are rewarded-S1 D1 steps right after an unrewarded or rare trial broke the streak' is not supported. Inside the predicate, precision is 0.85 when trial -2 was also a common-rewarded a1 and 0.83 when it was not; it is 0.80 when trial -2 was unrewarded. The test misses also show false positives in the middle of long a1/S1c rewarded streaks. The false positives line up with the model's own value output instead: value>7.4 gives precision 1.0 and value<7.4 gives 0.63.

'Goes with good==S1' is only a correlate. Inside the predicate, precision is 0.83 when good==S2 against 0.84 when good==S1, so the hidden good state adds nothing beyond the a1/common/rewarded history.

The checks that hold up: D1 only (no GO or D2 activations at all), in_rew==1 only (0 activations when in_rew is 0 or -1), almost all mass on action==1 (0.998), and misses hold only 0.2% of the mass (test). With prev unknown (first trial) and action==2, precision is 0.002, so the upcoming-choice gate is real.

Observed-only check: (D1)&(in_rew==1)&isin(prev_action,[1,-1])&isin(prev_common,[1,-1]) scores test F1 0.784 (precision 0.65). That beats the reported observed-only version (dev F1 0.75), but the agent's upcoming choice is still needed to reach about 0.90.

label: D1 after a rewarded common a1->S1 trial (window start: rewarded D1 while belief favours S1), silent in the last ~15 trials of the episode
explanation: Fires only at D1 and only when a reward is shown (in_rew == 1); never at GO or D2. The previous trial must have been a1 reaching S1 by a common transition (or be outside the window). Requiring the ideal-observer belief that S1 is good (belief > 0.5) replaces the banned upcoming-choice term (dev precision 0.66 -> 0.81), and the feature is silent late in the episode (none at ep_trial 90-99, weak at 80-89), so ep_trial < 85 lifts precision to 0.95 (dev F1 0.945). Remaining errors are mostly window-start steps where the unseen previous trial was a2 or belief is weak.

issues: Minor label framing: 'while observed history favours S1' reads as a general condition, but when the previous trial is in the window belief adds nothing (rewarded a1->S1 with ep_trial<85: precision 0.9724 without the belief clause, 0.9726 with it). Belief matters only on window-start steps (precision 0.83, 20% of mass).
Claims hold: never at GO/D2; silent from ep_trial >= 85 (precision 0.007, 0.03% of mass) and weak at 80-84 (0.8% of mass); rewarded rare a2->S1 D1s rarely fire (precision 0.11, 0.4% of mass).
Upcoming a1 is the cleaner description ((in_rew==1)&(action==1)&(ep_trial<85): recall 0.989, mass recall 0.998), but the observed rule is close: adding action==1 lifts test F1 only 0.939 -> 0.951.
Note: this is nearly the same predicate as hidden/118, with the ep_trial<85 cutoff as the main difference.
